stem.text: Menthol is a naturally occurring alcohol.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of menthol: cyclohexane ring with a methyl group, an isopropyl group and an OH group on adjacent carbons.
stem.label: menthol

stem.text: When menthol is heated with concentrated sulfuric acid it reacts. The products formed include compound T.
What could be the structure of compound T?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a methyl group on one carbon and an exocyclic C=C to a C(CH3)2 group on the carbon opposite.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexanone ring with a methyl group, and a ketone C=O next to a carbon bearing an isopropyl group.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a methyl group on one alkene carbon and an isopropyl group on the carbon opposite.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a methyl group at the top, an isopropyl group at the bottom and the ring C=C on the left-hand side.
